verdict: A disciplined, well-weighted Plex Sans résumé with a sound three-colour system, undermined by an orphaned header line, a measure of ~100 characters that spawns six one- or two-word tail lines, an under-differentiated type scale, and roughly a dozen small embellishments that are not in the verified facts.

issues.problem: The first contact line holds only "Sana’a, Yemen ·" with a dangling middle-dot separator, then the rest wraps to line two. It is the most visible line on page 1 and reads as a rendering bug; the trailing separator also leaks into the ATS text as a line ending in "·".
issues.fix:
.contact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;column-gap:0;row-gap:2pt;font-size:9pt;color:#566173} .contact span{white-space:nowrap} .contact span+span::before{content:"\00a0·\00a0";color:#566173} — never put the separator inside the text. If a two-line split is wanted, force it: line 1 "Sana’a, Yemen · Remote (GMT+3) · WhatsApp +967 770 941 666", line 2 "moain.learn@gmail.com · github.com/MoTechSys · alabbasi.uk" (
between, no trailing dot).

issues.problem: Start of professional career is UNKNOWN in the facts sheet; only repository dates (2026) exist. A date range on the only employment line is a verifiable claim a recruiter will probe; if it is only inferred from repo timestamps it is unverified.
issues.fix: Confirm the founding date with the candidate. If it cannot be confirmed, remove "2026 – Present" from the line (keep the right-aligned slot empty or use the verified project-year context elsewhere); do not substitute another date.

issues.where: "Google Ads tooling for Keif Al-Diafa (Jeddah)" and "Websites for Saudi hospitality brands: keifaldiafa.com, asoulaldiafa.com, qahwajeen.com"
issues.problem: "(Jeddah)" and "Saudi" are not in the verified facts; only HTTP-200 status of the three sites and the repo name keif-aldiafa-ads-platform are confirmed. Geographic client claims are exactly what Saudi hiring managers will check.
issues.fix: Unless the candidate confirms, change to "Google Ads tooling for Keif Al-Diafa" and "Websites for hospitality brands: keifaldiafa.com, asoulaldiafa.com, qahwajeen.com."

issues.where: Multiple unverified qualifiers: "ReAct executor", "skills saved from successful runs" (Mansur); "(Claude, GPT-5, DeepSeek or a local model)" (Ai_Alabbasi); "bilingual Arabic/English posts" (Promoter); "Arabic SEO content" (Bina); "in GitHub Actions" (remote access); "foreground service" (Nexus); "including automatic blocking of SSH brute-force attacks" (SOC); "in their native language" (Ghaida); "from licensed corpora", "never decides a verdict" (Basira)
issues.problem: None of these phrases appear in the verified READMEs/facts. Individually small, together they inflate every entry beyond what the repos document, and a reviewer who opens one repo and fails to find "GPT-5" or "licensed corpora" will discount the rest.
issues.fix: Delete each unverified qualifier or replace with the verified wording: Mansur → "planner, executor, verifier and learner orchestrated with LangGraph"; Ai_Alabbasi → "Coding agent with a swappable model backend"; Promoter → "write posts for six platforms"; Bina → "reusable agents for website audit (205 checks), rebuild and content"; remote access → "releases keyless-signed with cosign"; Nexus → "native Android SMS gateway (dual SIM)"; SOC → delete the "including …" clause; Ghaida → "Household guidebook for domestic workers with AI voice for every sentence"; Basira → "Verifies Quran and Hadith quotations against 71,987 records; an optional LLM only proposes spans and reads images (OCR)."

issues.where: Measure: median 100, max 113 characters per line at 10 pt (text width 170 mm)
issues.problem: 100–113 characters is 25–40 % beyond the comfortable 65–85 for continuous text; the eye loses the return sweep in the dense paragraph-style project blocks (Basira, Idhaat). The 1.43 leading partly compensates but cannot fix a measure this long.
issues.fix: @page{margin:18mm 23mm 18mm 23mm} (text width 164 mm ≈ 95 ch) and body{font-size:10pt;line-height:14.5pt}. Combined with the trailer shortenings below the document still fits two pages (page 2 has 43 mm spare).

issues.where: Tail lines: "BullMQ, OpenAPI", "WebSocket, SQLite", "Tailwind 4", "accounting system.", "Actions. — Go, SSH, NetBird", "Jetpack Compose, ML Kit"
issues.problem: Six entries end with a one- to three-word grey 9 pt fragment on its own line. These orphaned stack tails break the vertical rhythm, look like leftovers and in the skills table split a value mid-list.
issues.fix: p, li{text-wrap:pretty; orphans:2; widows:2} and shorten three trailers so they fit: POS → "— NestJS 10, React 19, Oracle PL/SQL"; Mansur → "— Python, LangGraph, FastAPI"; S-ACM sentence → "Academic content manager with AI summarisation and question generation. — React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4".

issues.problem: Automatic hyphenation split "multi-tenant" across lines; pdftotext dropped the hyphen and produced the non-word "multitenant", which an ATS keyword match for "multi-tenant" will miss.
issues.fix: body{hyphens:manual} and write the compound with a non-breaking hyphen: "multi\u2011tenant" (U+2011) in Summary, Motech Attendance and Nexus Notify.

issues.problem: Section headings (11.6 pt) are only 16 % larger than body text and smaller than the tagline (12.49 pt); hierarchy rests entirely on blue + caps. The non-integer 11.6 and 12.49 also signal an unrounded scale.
issues.fix: Use a 1.2 ratio scale on a 14 pt baseline: .stack{font-size:9pt} body{font-size:10pt} h2.section{font-size:12pt;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase} .tagline{font-size:13.5pt} h1{font-size:24pt;letter-spacing:-.01em}.

issues.problem: A 14.25 pt line pitch gives no clean baseline grid; heading margins and the rule-to-text gaps do not sit on multiples of it, so page 2 blocks drift visibly against page 1.
issues.fix: body{line-height:14pt} h2.section{margin:14pt 0 7pt;padding-bottom:3pt;border-bottom:.4pt solid #c9ced6} .entry{margin-bottom:7pt} li{margin-bottom:3.5pt} — all vertical values multiples of 3.5 pt.

issues.where: Page margins: top 14.3 mm vs sides 20 mm; page 2 no running footer
issues.problem: The name sits 14 mm from the trim while sides are 20 mm, so the header feels pushed up; page 2 starts mid-section with "Ai_Alabbasi" and carries no name or page number, so a detached second sheet is anonymous.
issues.fix: @page{margin:18mm 23mm} @page{@bottom-center{content:"Moain Al-Abbasi · " counter(page) " / " counter(pages);font:8pt 'IBM Plex Sans';color:#566173}} and .entry,li{break-inside:avoid}.

issues.where: Experience list: last bullet "Websites for Saudi hospitality brands: …"
issues.problem: Every other bullet opens with a semibold project name followed by an em dash; the last bullet has no bold lead-in, so the scanning pattern breaks on the final item.
issues.fix: Render "Websites" in the same .lead{font-weight:600} style: "Websites — hospitality brands: keifaldiafa.com, asoulaldiafa.com, qahwajeen.com. In development: …".

issues.problem: It is the only project entry without a repository link and without a stack trailer, and it happens to be the first thing on page 2, so the inconsistency is prominent.
issues.fix: Add the stack trailer from verified facts: "— Python, SQLite FTS5"; if the repo is private, append "(private repository)" after the title exactly as done for Mansur AI.

issues.where: Technical Skills table: "Frontend & mobile" and "DevOps & security" labels
issues.problem: The label column is ~34 mm and these two labels run to within ~2 mm of the value column, so the gutter collapses and the table loses its alignment edge.

issues.where: Technical Skills: row "Languages — Arabic (native), English (technical reading and writing)"
issues.problem: Human languages sit inside a section titled TECHNICAL SKILLS, a category error that also confuses ATS skill parsers that treat every row as a technology.
issues.fix: Rename the section heading to "SKILLS" or move the row under its own 12 pt heading "LANGUAGES" immediately after Technical Skills.

issues.where: Header "Sana’a, Yemen · Remote (GMT+3)" and Experience line "Alabbasi Tech (alabbasi.uk) · Sana’a, Yemen · Remote"
issues.problem: Location and "Remote" are stated twice within 25 mm; the repetition costs a line in the tightest part of page 1.
issues.fix: Experience line → "Founder & Software Engineer · Alabbasi Tech (alabbasi.uk)" with the date slot right-aligned; keep location only in the header.

issues.where: Inline stack trailers in #566173 at 9 pt ("— NestJS 10, React 19 …")
issues.problem: Switching size and colour mid-line forces a 1 pt baseline jump and a lighter colour inside justified-looking text; it works in a single line but degrades when the trailer wraps (see tail-line issue). Contrast itself (6.26:1) is fine.
issues.fix: .stack{font-size:9pt;color:#566173;vertical-align:baseline;letter-spacing:.01em} and insert the separator as .stack::before{content:"\00a0— "} so the em dash never ends a line alone.

issues.where: Section "GRADUATION PROJECT (TEAM)" with no Education section
issues.problem: A graduation project implies a degree, yet university, degree and year are UNKNOWN and absent; ATS parsers expect an Education block and recruiters will notice the gap. No data may be invented.
issues.fix: Keep the section as is; obtain university/degree/year from the candidate before the next revision and only then add "EDUCATION". Do not add placeholders.

issues.where: Arabic body face (Noto Naskh Arabic) paired with IBM Plex Sans
issues.problem: Noto Naskh is a calligraphic text face with low x-height contrast against the geometric Plex Sans, so bilingual lines show a visible weight and colour mismatch. It was retained because it is the only face that extracted 100 % — that constraint must be preserved.
issues.fix: Trial IBM Plex Sans Arabic (same designer, matched stroke and weights). Extraction correctness depends on the PDF ToUnicode map the renderer emits, not the glyph design: render with Chromium/Playwright (HarfBuzz shaping, ToUnicode written per glyph), embed the full TTF (no subsetting of shaping tables), then run pdftotext -raw and diff against the source string; adopt Plex Sans Arabic only if the diff is empty for every page, otherwise keep Noto Naskh Arabic.
